description: Creates a NEW empty sheet owned by the authenticated user and returns its sheetId. Every sheet holds people and companies together: each row is a person with their company beside, or a company with nobody yet. mode is accepted and ignored. A sheet the user already has with the same name is returned instead of creating a duplicate. Sheets can be created here, not only in the dashboard.

mode.description: 'people' for contact sheets, 'company' for organization sheets.

name.description: Sheet name exactly as the user should see it in the dashboard.
